data.narrative:
Precision Neuroscience is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $180M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 3 public-company comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers, with particular reference to 3 same-stage, same-sector private companies: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two quantitative methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the company's $180M total raised, implying a valuation of $306M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same-stage private comps yields $3.8B (with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B). Public-company anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue figures for the target. The wide gap between these two methods reflects heterogeneity in the peer set: Colossal Biosciences commands a $10.3B valuation while New Limit stands at $3.1B, both at Series C.

The triangulated valuation range is $260M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.1B. Key uncertainties include the company's underlying clinical or technical progress relative to peers, revenue traction (not disclosed), and whether the company more closely resembles the lower-valuation or higher-valuation end of the Series C cohort. The stage-progression method anchors the conservative bound; peer comparison dominates the central estimate.
